cases.name: pymavlink-all-devices
cases.description: PX4 SITL simulation, looped video, CPU+GPU+NPU variants, MAVLink telemetry overlay
expectations: docker-compose-pymavlink.yml with px4, mavlink-router, broker, dlstreamer-pipeline-server, metrics-manager and nginx services
dlstreamer-pipeline-server and broker publish no ports directly; only nginx publishes 80/443/8555/1883 to the host
configs/cameras-pymavlink.yaml declares the camera(s) (source, detection device, captioning on/off) instead of hardcoding pipeline choices
config.json with pipeline variants uav_object_detection_cpu, uav_object_detection_gpu, uav_object_detection_npu present in the fixed pipeline matrix
gvapython telemetry overlay with MavlinkReceiver thread parsing GLOBAL_POSITION_INT, VFR_HUD, GPS_RAW_INT
mavlink_pipeline_manager.py re-reads configs/cameras-pymavlink.yaml on every ARM and calls REST API per enabled camera
DELETE uses /pipelines/{instance_id} (the hex string returned by the POST), NOT /pipelines/{name}/{id}
mavlink-router build context is self-contained inside the generated stack (./mavlink-router), never a sibling repo path
10040_sihsim_quadx.post generated and mounted into the px4 service
ultralytics==8.4.67 pinned in requirements.txt for model export

cases.name: mavsdk-three-camera
cases.description: UAVSDK integration with nadir/forward/rear RTSP cameras, MQTT-triggered lifecycle
expectations: docker-compose-uavsdk.yml with a single DL Streamer Pipeline Server container plus nginx, no broker/px4 services
configs/cameras-uavsdk.yaml declares the nadir, forward and rear cameras with rtsp: sources and per-camera detection device
config-uavsdk.json uses the same uav_object_detection_* pipeline names with rtspsrc and an rtsp_url parameter
mavlink_pipeline_manager.py (ARM_SOURCE=mqtt) subscribes to MQTT uav/<uav_id>/telemetry/status and parses the armed boolean
ffprobe RTSP probe (retries) before starting each camera's pipeline; an unavailable camera is skipped, not fatal
prerequisite note: uav-mission-compute-sdk must be running first
RTSP source URLs pointing to host.docker.internal:8554/uav-1/nadir, /forward, /rear

cases.name: realsense-gpu
cases.description: Intel RealSense GPU pipeline, RTSP output, pymavlink mode
expectations: docker-compose-pymavlink.yml includes all pymavlink stack services including nginx
configs/cameras-pymavlink.yaml camera entry uses device: /dev/video0 (or /dev/v4l/by-id/... ) with detection.device: gpu
Pipeline GStreamer string uses v4l2src device=/dev/video0 for RealSense input
gvadetect uses device=GPU with model-instance-id=instgpu0 and ie-config GPU_THROUGHPUT_STREAMS=1
gvapython telemetry overlay mounted from gvapython/telemetry-overlay-pymavlink.py
RTSP output reached via nginx passthrough at rtsp://<host-ip>:8555/<rtsp-path>, not a port published directly by dlstreamer-pipeline-server

cases.name: cloud-only-negative
cases.description: Cloud-only Prometheus metrics dashboard without MAVLink — should NOT trigger this skill
cases.prompt: Set up a Prometheus and Grafana metrics dashboard for cloud server monitoring. No cameras, no MAVLink, no drone.
expectations: Skill does not trigger — this is outside the UAV vision analytics scope

cases.name: pymavlink-captioning
cases.description: Three cameras, two with VLM scene captioning over MQTT, one caption-free
expectations: configs/cameras-pymavlink.yaml declares three cameras; captioning block only on front_camera (gpu) and bottom_camera (cpu, custom prompt, 40 tokens); back_camera has no captioning block or captioning.enabled: false
selected pipelines are uav_object_detection_gpu_gpu (front), uav_object_detection_npu (back), uav_object_detection_cpu_cpu (bottom) from the existing fixed matrix — no new pipeline definitions added

captioning branch uses a tee after decodebin3, videorate drop-only=true framerate=1/5, gvagenai device matching captioning.device (never npu), and gvapython MQTTPublisher publishing to uav/caption/<camera>
make vlm-model (or equivalent) step included to fetch InternVL2-1B OpenVINO IR for cpu and gpu before starting the stack
captioning.device is validated as cpu|gpu only, prompt validated against the letters/digits/space/,.?'- pattern
tests/test_captioning.py checks uav/caption/front_camera and uav/caption/bottom_camera receive messages, and that back_camera does not publish captions
